import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t,x,v,y=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
g=t*v**3
def model(p): return p[0]*t + p[1]/(1+p[2]*x)/v + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*x**2) + p[5]*g
best=None
for s in range(8):
    r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-y, np.random.RandomState(s).randn(6))
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
p=best.x; print(np.round(p,4))
res=y-model(p)
for name,z in [('t',t),('x',x),('v',v)]:
    qs=np.quantile(z,np.linspace(0,1,6))
    idx=np.digitize(z,qs[1:-1])
    print(name,[round(res[idx==k].mean(),4) for k in range(5)], [round(res[idx==k].std(),4) for k in range(5)])
